column1: # removed-plugins.tsv: every plugin whose .claude-plugin/plugin.json git history deleted.
# Tab-separated, no header row, '#' lines are comments. Read with: awk -F'\t' '/^#/{next} …'
# Rows are sorted by name; rows appended later by remove-plugin.sh may sit unsorted at the end.
# removed: the deleting (or renaming) commit's author date, --date=short.
# successor: a current plugin, or the literal null. Name one only when a single plugin absorbed
#   the removed one AND it registers no blocking hook the removed one lacked, because a renames
#   successor is installed on a user's machine without asking. A blocking hook is a Stop or
#   SubagentStop registration, a PreToolUse script that can emit permissionDecision deny/ask or
#   exit 2, a PermissionRequest hook, or a prompt/agent-type hook that can deny; PostToolUse,
#   UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart command hooks never count. A split, a chain, a retired
#   plugin or a capability later deleted is null.
# Every successor was a current plugin or null when this file was written. The column follows
#   the host's renames semantics: append-only, chains followed and never rewritten, so a row may
#   later name a since-removed plugin (user decision 2026-09-29).
# prose_match: which pc_removed_refs list in scripts/lib/plugin-checks.sh holds the name.
#   plug  = `n`, → n, "n bundle(s)", /n:, plugins/n, n@, **n**, "n plugin" — NOT `n:x`, which
#           only moved carries (hence dev-env is both)
#   moved = the plugin-reference-forms-only list (/n:, `n:x`, plugins/n, n@, **n**, "n plugin")
#   Two values cannot reproduce two lists with different shape sets plus one name in both,
# Regenerate the name and removed columns (repo root; --no-renames is load-bearing: without it
# the two July renames, grill-me and taskman, report as R instead of D and drop out):
# git log --no-renames --diff-filter=D --date=short --format='@%h %ad' --name-only -- 'plugins/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json' | awk '/^@/{c=$0;next} NF{split($0,a,"/"); print a[2]"\t"c}' | sort
# Regenerate marketplace.json's renames map from this file (repo root). It rewrites the whole map,
# so run it only when every pc_renames_ledger finding is renames-missing: on renames-orphan or
# renames-mismatch it would drop or retarget a committed key, and renames is append-only history —
# a user still on the old name is stranded. Fix those by adding or correcting this file's row;
# never drop or retarget a committed renames key.

# tmp=$(mktemp) && jq --rawfile t scripts/removed-plugins.tsv '. + {forceRemoveDeletedPlugins: true, renames: ([$t | split("\n")[] | select(startswith("#") | not) | sub("\r$"; "") | select(test("^[ \t]*$") | not) | split("\t") | {(.[0]): (if .[1] == "null" then null else .[1] end)}] | add)}' .claude-plugin/marketplace.json > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
